title: TUR problem report
description: report.json: the member that turns a support bundle into a problem report (ADR-0024; docs/architecture/problem-reports.md). Written on one line by tur-diag report prepare and redacted with the rest of the bundle. The Rust type tur_diag::report::ReportRequest is authoritative and a test compares the two. The receiver accepts each text up to twice the limits stated here, because a pseudonym can be longer than what it replaced. Error messages about this document name the field, never its value.

kind.description: What kind of problem this is.

title.description: One line naming the problem. Not blank; no control characters.

description.description: What happened, in words. Line breaks and tabs allowed; no other control characters.

error_code.description: A TUR error code (specification 29.3), or null.

component.description: The component concerned. A fixed list, so that nothing personal can travel in a field that groups reports.

affected_version.description: The TUR version the problem is in when it is not the running one; for a failed update, the version that failed. null otherwise.

boot_health.description: What boot health recorded, for a report made from its pending notice (tur-diag report prepare --from-boot-health). null otherwise.
